scope: dry single-tile WRFParity mode3 ImplicitOnly selected endpoint reference plan; not computed numerical bound
equations: For physical mass cells j=0..m-1,i=0..n-1 (m=80,n=40), construct M=projected_mu+MUB. U face masses use 0.5*(left+right), periodic seam avg(last,first) at faces 0,n. V face masses use replicated M at south/north walls and interior 0.5*(south+north).
CU=(c1h*M_u+c2h)*projected_u/msfuy; CV=(c1h*M_v+c2h)*projected_v*(1/msfvx); per level d=msftx*dnw*(rdx*(CU_e-CU_w)+rdy*(CV_n-CV_s)); dnw=-1/getRdnwTensor(FP64). For no HEVI F_mu=msfty*sum_k(d).

Reference F_W canonical product correction is -W*extend_w(c1f*F_mu/level_mass_w), in addition to W pressure/buoyancy; Q_W is final copy/alias projection. Do not freeze mu_tend without bounding its input and arithmetic error.

Source column sum may use backend reduction order; directed MPFR exact-real sum evaluates target mathematical sum, but native-vs-real enclosure must explicitly cover floating-point reciprocal, products, differences, reduction, division and addition; no assumed backend gamma factor.
boundary: Packed Q mass repeats x first column and y last physical row. U core keeps n faces then appends first two faces; V symmetric normal faces at global jds/jde are zeroed before core extraction, x first column repeated and north ghost reflected odd. Diagnose uses U first n+1 and V first m+1 physical faces.
Base state MUB is passed separately and cropped physical core, not automatically projected with state Q. dnw uses negative reciprocal RDNW, not raw positive RDNW or horizontal RDN.
profile: Archived native logs show mode3, mass_coordinate_mode1 => omega WRF and horizontal-only mass, HEVI and split-explicit off, autograd FP64; wrapper fast mode excludes direct F_phys.

mu_tend_fortran_parity source default is true but archived log does not explicitly confirm its effective state; require observed/config pinned evidence or include mean-subtract/clamp branch. Require finite values and record sanitation/guard activation and fixed geometry/flags.
minimum_inputs: Full source-matched CPU FP64 B, accepted K0/K1 (or both exact ideal Y and proven Q(B+aK) formation enclosure), actual accepted native residual/RHS W values and actual S_inv W values, stage coefficient and exact layout/provenance. Hash-only old K/R is insufficient.

Exact dtype/shape/value of base MUB, c1h,c2h,c1f,c2f, RDNW as actually returned by fallback, msftx,msfty,msfuy,msfvx, rdx/rdy scalars, Q/branch topology, dry flag and parity/sanitize flags; account fixed-value conversion and any roundoff in coefficient construction.

All EOS pressure/PH/base inputs and consumer coefficients required for pressure/buoyancy plus other active implicit W terms, so a μdot component is not mislabeled full W reference. Compare output using directed norms and account native formation and projection alias multiplicities.
limits: Existing retained EOS arrays alone omit U/V and full B/K/R/S arrays.
